releaseNotes: Continues the independent unified Chrome PWA for phone and computer. Android APK, iOS and Computer deliveries remain separate.
Smart Review opens directly at Your Session; Smart Recommended remains available as a compact action within the session panel.
Overview keeps its statistics, topic mastery map and mastery journey while removing the due-today / 20-question hero card only.
Empty Schedule state no longer displays the redundant Choose a topic button.
Pediatrics Start Studying opens the collection chooser first. The doctor MCQ bank and Previous Questions remain separate and are grouped by their existing system/topic mapping.
The side menu keeps the existing Exam Goal Planner under Your Progress and removes the duplicate extension entry.
Question bank records, stable question IDs, question wording, option labels, answer keys and explanations are preserved.
